summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-mcp preinstall stages Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's `preinstall` hook runs `node setup.mjs`, itself obfuscated with hex-style identifier renaming and per-function string-lookup objects. `setup.mjs` checks for a system `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads a pinned Bun release from GitHub, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then uses that freshly staged runtime to `execFileSync` a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (rotating string array via `WV8StW`, several-thousand-element mixed hex/string constant array, custom character-map decoder). The advertised purpose of the package is an MCP React documentation server, whose functional code lives in `dist/` and does not require an alternate language runtime or a separate pre-execution step. Using an out-of-band runtime to run an opaque bundled payload at install time bypasses Node-based auditing and delivers unknown code execution to any host running `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
